articles.title: Critical Google DevSite Flaw Allowed Attackers to Execute Remote Code Without Authentication
articles.summary:
A critical security vulnerability in Google’s shared DevSite platform could have let unauthenticated attackers execute arbitrary code on Google-hosted services by forging Flask session cookies with malicious Python pickle payloads. Security researcher Simon Köck discovered the issue while analyzing the OAuth authorization workflow used by Google’s developer documentation properties. articles.title: Critical WordPress Bricksforge Flaw Lets Unauthenticated Attackers Execute Remote Code
articles.summary:
Attackers are actively targeting a critical vulnerability in the Bricksforge WordPress plugin. This flaw allows unauthenticated users to upload malicious files and execute arbitrary PHP code. It is tracked as CVE-2026-85097 and has a CVSS score of 10.0, affecting versions up to 3.1.8.9. Administrators are advised to upgrade to version 3.1.8.10 or later. Patchstack disclosed […]

articles.title: Discourse ImageMagick Vulnerability Enables Arbitrary File Read Through Malicious Image Uploads
articles.summary:
Security researchers have revealed a critical vulnerability in Discourse, tracked as CVE-2026-55420. This flaw could let a low-privileged user read and write files on the underlying server by exploiting the platform’s ImageMagick-based upload pipeline. The issue was fixed for hosted customers in June 2026 and was publicly disclosed on June 30, 2026. The vulnerability affects […]

articles.title: WhatsApp-Delivered Malware Injects Into Windows Task Scheduler to Run as SYSTEM
articles.summary:
A WhatsApp-delivered financial-document lure is being used to deploy a sophisticated Windows malware chain that injects code into the Task Scheduler service and executes subsequent payloads with LocalSystem privileges. The executable acts as an NRV2E-compressed wrapper that reconstructs its malicious loader entirely in memory, limiting obvious artifacts on disk and obscuring imports, strings, and control-flow […]

articles.title: AnyDesk Vulnerability Allowing Remote Code Execution With Root Privileges
articles.summary:

This vulnerability allows remote command execution before the user approves desktop control.
